name: 86 Chaos 18.0.7
label: 86 Chaos 18.0.7
notes: Android system-bar/display-cutout insets are applied to the native activity content container, not the WebView.
The WebView receives zero internal system-bar padding so fixed-position web UI uses the already-constrained viewport.
The 86 Chaos Android launcher icon remains branded.
iPhone/iPad safe-area fallback remains in place.
Only targeted mobile tests are run; no full Release Gate.
title: 86 Chaos 18.0.7
summary: Moves Android system-bar insets to the native activity content container so the WebView viewport itself stays between the status and navigation bars.
description: Repairs the real-device Android overlap reported after 18.0.6 while preserving branded launcher assets, testing-only Firebase routing, and iPhone/iPad safe-area behavior.
highlights: Packaged native app no longer sends /api requests to the phone-local asset server.
CapacitorHttp carries authenticated API calls to https://testing.86chaos.com while Firebase stays on the testing project.
Android and iOS native versions are aligned to 18.0.1 / build 180001.
Targeted Android Chromium and iPhone WebKit coverage includes the packaged API bridge contract.
